exercises.why: **Настал** — наста́ть (perfective): to come, to begin (of time). Wiktionary: на- + стать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **Отстань** — отста́ть (perfective): to fall behind, to lag (to be below average in performance); to be slow (of a clock); to be backward / behind; to be retarded; to come / fall off, to peel off. Wiktionary: от- + стать.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: отста́ть — to fall behind, to lag (to be below average in performance); достава́ть — to reach, to touch; расстава́ться — to part, to separate; пристава́ть — to stick, to adhere.
